req.title: Task has default completed=false
req.statement: The system shall default the completed field to false when POST /tasks/ omits it.

doc.reasoning: The requirement specifies that when a task is created without specifying the 'completed' field, it should default to 'false'. This behavior needs to be verified through positive, negative, and boundary test cases to ensure robustness against common mutations.

tests.name: test_create_task_default_completed_false
preconditions: The FastAPI app is running in test mode.
actions: Send a POST request to /tasks/ with a task payload omitting the 'completed' field.
expected: The 'completed' field in the response payload is false.
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app.main import app

client = TestClient(app)

response = client.post("/tasks/", json={"title": "Test Task", "description": "A task without completed field."})
assert response.status_code == 201
assert response.json()["completed"] is False

tests.name: test_create_task_invalid_payload
preconditions: The FastAPI app is running in test mode.
actions: Send a POST request to /tasks/ with an invalid payload missing the 'title' field.
expected: The response status code is 422 indicating a validation error.
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app.main import app

client = TestClient(app)

response = client.post("/tasks/", json={"description": "Missing title field."})
assert response.status_code == 422

tests.name: test_create_task_boundary_title_length
preconditions: The FastAPI app is running in test mode.
actions: Send a POST request to /tasks/ with a task payload where the 'title' field is exactly 100 characters long.
expected: The 'completed' field in the response payload is false.
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app.main import app

client = TestClient(app)

title_100_chars = "T" * 100
response = client.post("/tasks/", json={"title": title_100_chars, "description": "Boundary test for title length."})
assert response.status_code == 201
assert response.json()["completed"] is False
